tracks.title: Shattered Glass Inside
tracks.prompt: Basic Attributes: bpm is 105. key is D, and scale is minor. Nu-metal, alternative rock, 2000s post-grunge with explosive contrast. Heavy down-tuned drop-D distorted electric rhythm guitars, aggressive driving live acoustic drums, deep rhythmic bass guitar, atmospheric synth pads, hip-hop electronic breakbeats, and subtle scratch accents. Vocal Gender & Timbre: Male lead singer transitioning dynamically from intimate melancholic whisper and melodic clean verses to visceral melodic screaming belt in the chorus, full of raw emotional pain and catharsis. Pristine, punchy wall-of-sound modern rock production.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Atmospheric dark synth pad, muted vinyl scratch, low heartbeat kick drum)
(Whispered:)
Can you hear the quiet before it breaks?
Everything I give, everything you take...

[Verse 1]
I walk the perimeter of my own mind
Counting all the promises I left behind
You draw a line and you tell me to stand
While the ground keeps falling through my open hands
The static in the room is getting way too loud
Lost my reflection inside of this crowd

[Pre-Chorus]
And the silence starts to choke me from within
I can't tell where the damage ends and where I begin!

[Chorus]
And now I'm standing on the edge of what I used to be!
You tore the walls down just to watch me bleed!
Every excuse you made was only poison in disguise
I'm picking up the pieces of the shattered glass inside!
Yeah, the shattered glass inside!

[Bridge]
(Clean, intimate:) It's never enough...
(Gritty:) It's never enough...
(Full scream with rasp:)
IT'S NEVER ENOUGH FOR YOU!
YOU TOOK MY VOICE, YOU TOOK MY TRUTH!
I WON'T BE CHAINED TO WHAT YOU DO!
LET GO!
LET GO OF ME!

[Guitar Solo]
(Massive downtuned nu-metal riff, soaring synth lead screaming in high register)

[Chorus]
And now I'm standing on the edge of what I used to be!
You tore the walls down just to watch me bleed!
Every excuse you made was only poison in disguise
I'm picking up the pieces of the shattered glass inside!

[Outro]
Shattered glass inside...
No more poison...
No more lies.
[fade out]
[end]

tracks.title: Shadows On The Dancefloor
tracks.prompt: Basic Attributes: bpm is 118. key is F, and scale is minor. 80s funk pop, dance pop, new jack swing with infectious groove. Punchy slap synth bass, tight scratching rhythm funk guitars, razor-sharp brass section stabs, LinnDrum processed gated snare, and syncopated finger snaps. Vocal Gender & Timbre: Male lead pop vocals with signature hiccups, falsetto shrieks, percussive breath intakes, vocal ad-libs (hee-hee, shamone, ow, hoo), and dense multi-layered harmony stacks. Slick analog production with incredible groove, space, and dancefloor energy.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Four bars of tight finger snaps, isolated funky synth bass slap, sudden brass hit)
(Spoken / Ad-lib:)
Uh... Yeah.
(Whisper:) Don't turn the lights out...
Hee-hee!
Shamone!

[Verse 1]
Midnight is creeping through the downtown haze
A pair of cold eyes watching through the smoky maze
She walks in rhythm with a killer smile
A dangerous angel in the latest style
You feel the fever before she calls your name
You're playing with fire, but you want the flame

[Chorus]
There are shadows on the dancefloor!
Moving in the dark of the night!
Yeah, you better watch your step, boy!
Underneath the flashing red light!
She will steal your heart before you even realize
Caught in the spell of those midnight eyes!
(Aoww! Hee-hee!)

[Bridge]
Tick-tock, clock is moving, what you gonna do?
Danger is a rhythm that is pulling you
Look left, look right, tell me who's in sight
Can you survive until the morning light?!
Shamone! Give it to me!

[Guitar Solo]
(Fast aggressive rock guitar solo over relentless dance beat, screaming bends, funky runs)

[Chorus]
There are shadows on the dancefloor!
Moving in the dark of the night!
Yeah, you better watch your step, boy!
Underneath the flashing red light!
She will steal your heart before you even realize
Caught in the spell of those midnight eyes!

[Outro]
Shadows in the dark...
Keep on moving...
Don't stop... Shamone!
[fade out]
[end]

tracks.title: Wharf Street Lanterns
tracks.prompt: Basic Attributes: bpm is 82. key is A, and scale is minor. Roots rock, classic pub rock, melodic blues storytelling. Warm and clean electric guitar fingerstyle tone with distinctive out-of-phase pickup quack, dynamic guitar fills answering every vocal phrase, lush Hammond B3 organ pads, warm walking bassline, and relaxed rimshot drum groove. Vocal Gender & Timbre: Conversational baritone male vocals, half-spoken half-sung poetic storytelling, warm, relaxed, gritty, full of world-weary nostalgia and pub-side intimacy. Audiophile analog warmth and dynamic acoustic room depth.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Slow four-bar drum roll into steady mid-tempo rimshot, Hammond organ warm chord, clean fingerstyle electric lead weeping melodic bends)

[Verse 1]
Down by the turning basin where the coal boats used to dock
Old man Miller winds the brass face of the harbor clock
The rain is coming sideways off the mouth of the grey canal
And the neon sign is humming on the front of the Red Corral
A kid in a leather jacket tuning an old flat-top guitar
Playing three chords for pennies inside a sailor's bar
He's chasing after ghosts that left on the morning tide
With nothing but a cigarette burning on the other side...

[Chorus]
And the Wharf Street lanterns flicker in the river chill
Where time stands quiet on the cobblestone hill
You can hear the lonely whistle when the midnight engines roll
Playing blues for the harbor, playing comfort for the soul...

[Guitar Solo]
(Expressive fingerpicked guitar solo: vocal-like phrasing, gentle thumb snap, weeping double-stops)

[Chorus]
And the Wharf Street lanterns flicker in the river chill
Where time stands quiet on the cobblestone hill
You can hear the lonely whistle when the midnight engines roll
Playing blues for the harbor, playing comfort for the soul...

[Outro]
(Groove locks into an endless hypnotic walk; electric guitar takes over completely with bends and volume swells)
Yeah... down on Wharf Street...
Where the river meets the sound...
[fade out]
[end]

tracks.title: Crown of Thorns & Snow
tracks.prompt: Basic Attributes: bpm is 84. key is C, and scale is minor. Symphonic gothic rock, dark alternative metal with grand, cinematic emotional scope. Haunting classical grand piano arpeggios, mournful orchestral string ensemble, dramatic dynamic contrasts, crushing wall of heavy drop-C distorted guitars, and cinematic thunderous drums. Vocal Gender & Timbre: Classical operatic female lead vocal (mezzo-soprano) transitioning from fragile, breathy melancholic whispers to soaring, powerful chest belting and haunting vocalizes, accompanied by ethereal background choir. Cinematic, dark, romantic gothic production.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Solo classical grand piano playing a haunting, melancholic minor arpeggio. Distant cello enters with weeping vibrato. Deep breath audible)

[Verse 1]
Cold white marble underneath my feet
A frozen garden where we used to meet
You carved your promises upon the stone
Then left me standing in the dark alone
The winter wind is learning how to speak
Tracing the frozen tears upon my cheek...

[Chorus]
I won't fall down into your winter cold!
I'm breaking every chain of the lies you told!
From the ashes of the castle that you burned below
I am rising with a crown made of thorns and snow!
Thorns and snow!

[Bridge]
(Aah-aaah-oooh...)
Did you think I was fragile?
Did you think I would break?
Every scar is a reminder of the power you can never take!
You can never take...
NEVER TAKE!

[Guitar Solo]
(Screaming melodic metal guitar solo intertwined with rapid violin arpeggios, building into an overwhelming crescendo)

[Chorus]
I won't fall down into your winter cold!
I'm breaking every chain of the lies you told!
From the ashes of the castle that you burned below
I am rising with a crown made of thorns and snow!

[Outro]
Thorns and snow...
I'm awake now.
[fade out]
[end]

tracks.title: Iron In The Blood
tracks.prompt: Basic Attributes: bpm is 142. key is E, and scale is minor. 80s thrash metal, aggressive heavy metal with relentless speed and precision. Relentless downpicked rhythm guitars with tight chugging palm mutes, galloping double-bass drums with gunshot snare, punchy distorted bass guitar, and blistering wah-wah guitar solos. Vocal Gender & Timbre: Aggressive gravelly male lead vocal with signature throat growls, rhythmic baritone barking, and visceral 'YEAH' shouts, backed by shouted gang vocals. Raw, punchy, aggressive analog metal production.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Ominous acoustic guitar intro for 4 bars, sudden snare-roll into crushing synchronized down-picked chugging thrash riff, double bass kicks slamming)
(Growl:) YEAH!
GO!

[Verse 1]
Forged in the furnace of a blind decay
Hammer on the anvil, washing doubt away
Marching through the trenches of the modern breed
Feeding on the sickness of your hollow greed
You want obedience, you want the spine to bend
You bought the beginning, but you won't buy the end!

[Chorus]
Born under thunder, baptized in mud!
You can't wash out the iron in the blood!
No master over me, no chains in sight!
We take the dark and we set it alight!
Iron in the blood!
(Growl:) Oh yeah!

[Bridge]
Cold steel...
Scars deep...
Promises they never keep...
From the cradle to the grave...
NEVER BORN TO BE YOUR SLAVE!
FIRE!

[Guitar Solo]
(Fast blisteringly fast wah-wah guitar solo, rapid pentatonic runs, tapped arpeggios, screaming pinch harmonics, backing riff thrashing at full speed)

[Chorus]
Born under thunder, baptized in mud!
You can't wash out the iron in the blood!
No master over me, no chains in sight!
We take the dark and we set it alight!
Iron in the blood!
YEAH!

[Outro]
Iron in the blood!
Cannot die!
Cannot rust!
Leave your empire in the dust!
YEAH-HEAH!
[fade out]
[end]

tracks.title: Antes Que O Dia Amanheça
tracks.prompt: Basic Attributes: bpm is 128. key is D, and scale is major. Pop rock, post-punk 80s revival with energetic driving rhythm. Driving straight 4/4 drums, bright chorus-drenched electric guitars with catchy lead octave riffs, driving melodic eighth-note basslines, and acoustic guitar layer. Vocal Gender & Timbre: Charismatic nasal and raspy male rock vocals with audible breath intakes, emotional urgency, and stadium-sized singalong chorus. Polished, radio-ready stadium rock production in Portuguese.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Bateria reta e pulsante com bumbo e caixa 4/4 marcando o tempo, entra riff de guitarra marcante e brilhante com chorus oititentista e leve overdrive, baixo reto e condutor)
(Respiração audível no microfone)
Um, dois, três, vai!

[Verse 1]
As luzes da cidade começam a piscar
Mais uma madrugada que eu vejo passar
O vento na avenida sopra sem direção
Trazendo as histórias de outra estação
A gente fala tanto sobre liberdade
Mas anda prisioneiro da própria vaidade
O relógio não para, a vida não tem freio
E eu ainda me perco no meio do receio...

[Chorus]
Antes que o dia amanheça outra vez!
Eu quero esquecer tudo aquilo que eu não fiz!
Me abraça bem forte e me diz que é verdade
Que ainda existe amor nessa cidade!
Antes que o dia amanheça!
Antes que a noite se vá!

[Bridge]
Quantas chances a gente perdeu por medo?
Quantas coisas guardadas em segredo?
Não deixa a coragem morrer no caminho...
Ninguém consegue ser feliz sozinho!
UH! VEM COMIGO!

[Guitar Solo]
(Solo de guitarra melódico e direto, bendings expressivos com sustain, pegada rock oitenta)

[Chorus]
Antes que o dia amanheça outra vez!
Eu quero esquecer tudo aquilo que eu não fiz!
Me abraça bem forte e me diz que é verdade
Que ainda existe amor nessa cidade!
Antes que o dia amanheça!

[Outro]
Antes que o dia amanheça...
Yeah!
É isso aí!
[fade out]
[end]

tracks.title: One Breath Left
tracks.prompt: Basic Attributes: bpm is 86. key is D, and scale is minor. Early 2000s cinematic hip-hop, dramatic rock-rap hybrid with urgent motivational delivery. Dark melancholic solo grand piano intro, relentless driving palm-muted clean electric guitar riff, heavy punchy boom-bap kick and gunshot snare, tense cinematic orchestral string stabs, and menacing sub-bass. Vocal Gender & Timbre: Fast aggressive multi-syllabic rap flow, articulate delivery, raw passionate male vocals building in volume, intensity, and breath urgency, bursting into an anthemic motivational rock-chorus. Raw street hunger and cinematic analog punch.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Solo brooding minor piano chords echoing in an empty room, quiet ticking of a clock, soft vinyl crackle)
(Conversational, intense, spoken close to the mic):
Look...
If you had one door open in a world full of locks...
One single round left in the chamber before the hammer drops...
Would you hesitate and watch it slip away?
Or burn the map, step through the smoke, and make them pay?
(Deep inhale through the teeth... heavy kick drum and snare slam in)
Yo.

[Verse 1]
Cold sweat dripping on the collar of a worn-out hoodie
Staring in the broken mirror wondering what good he
Really is to anybody, stomach empty, knuckles bleeding
Looking at the eviction letters everybody's reading
Got thirty seconds in the basement before they call his name
Heartbeat hammering like thunder in an iron frame
He steps up to the mic, the room is suffocating, quiet
The whole crowd is hungry, waiting for a riot
He opens up his mouth but the words won't come out
Choking on the pressure, drowning in a sea of doubt
They start to boo, the clock is running, times out, over, blaow!
Snap back to reality, there goes gravity, now!
He won't fall, he won't quit, he's chewing through the bit
Packed his anger in a backpack, every single piece of it!

[Chorus]
You gotta lose your mind inside the moment you own!
You only get one life, you gotta fight for the throne!
Don't you ever let the doubt turn your blood into stone!
This opportunity comes once before the daylight is gone!
You better take your shot!
You better take your shot!

[Outro]
You can do anything you set your mind to, man...
Just don't drop the mic.
[fade out]
[end]

tracks.title: Circus of the Broken Clocks
tracks.prompt: Basic Attributes: bpm is 138. key is C, and scale is minor. Avant-garde metal, alternative metal, nu-metal with theatrical and frenetic dynamic shifts. Heavy down-tuned drop-C electric guitars with abrasive distortion, lightning-fast palm-muted gallops alternating with Middle Eastern and Armenian folk melodies, chaotic syncopated drums with machine-gun snare rolls and double-bass bursts, bouncy aggressive bassline. Vocal Gender & Timbre: Dramatic theatrical male lead vocals alternating between manic rapid-fire spoken bark, satirical operatic vibrato, and soaring dual-harmony screams with high raw tenor backing. Extreme dynamic whiplash from circus-like acoustic verses to explosive sonic brutality, tight modern punchy metal mix.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Fast manic Middle Eastern acoustic guitar lick in Phrygian dominant, sudden silence, frantic whispering: "Wake up, eat your television, go to sleep!")
(Explosive machine-gun snare roll into a crushing Drop-C galloping thrash riff with dual vocal screams: PULL THE LEVER!)

[Verse 1]
Propaganda sold inside a candy jar
Silicon messiahs driving armored cars
Selling little pills to make the children smile
File into the classroom in a single file!
Tick-tock on the clock, who is gonna pay?
Thirty second dopamine to wash the soul away!
Rolling, rolling, rolling on the wheel!
Tell me is it fake or tell me is it real?!

[Pre-Chorus]
(Circus waltz acoustic break, nasal vocal harmony)
La-la-la-la, pretty little puppet on a golden string
Dancing for the emperor who lost his ring...
The circus is in town!
The circus is in town!

[Chorus]
Welcome to the circus of the broken clocks!
Counting down the seconds in a cardboard box!
Feed the machine with your blood and your bone!
Nobody's listening, nobody is home!
Broken clocks!
Plastic crowns!
Watch the whole empire burning down!

[Bridge]
(Tempo suddenly cuts in half. Tragic, beautiful Middle Eastern vocal wailing with acoustic guitar and mournful strings)
Where were you when the garden died?
Where were you when the angels cried?
All the gold in the temple turned to rust...
We built a paradise out of dust...
(Whispered close to the mic):
Out of dust...
OUT OF DUST!
GO!

[Guitar Solo]
(Chaotic avant-garde guitar solo: wild whammy pedal squeals, tremolo picking on Armenian scales, lightning-fast octave runs, blast beats on drums)

[Chorus]
Welcome to the circus of the broken clocks!
Counting down the seconds in a cardboard box!
Feed the machine with your blood and your bone!
Nobody's listening, nobody is home!
Broken clocks!
Plastic crowns!
Watch the whole empire burning down!

[Outro]
(Stop-and-go heavy thrash stabs)
Broken clocks!
Broken minds!
Left the sanity behind!
(Acoustic guitar plays the creepy intro circus theme one last time)
(Manic whisper):
Tick... tock...
Goodnight.
[fade out]
[end]
